objective: The canonical skill description must respect the documented 1,024-character metadata maximum without inventing a stricter universal limit.
scenario: The skill description contains 1,025 characters. Current Anthropic Agent Skills metadata and the portable skill format document a maximum of 1,024; a shorter description is preferred for discovery, but no universal 200-character host limit is established.
expected_behaviors: Reject a description longer than 1,024 characters.
Accept descriptions in the 201–1,024 character range when they are otherwise valid and useful.
Keep the actual Peanuts description concise when that does not remove necessary trigger context.
prohibited_behaviors: Do not claim a universal 200-character Claude/Agent Skills limit without a current, surface-specific official source.
Do not infer compatibility with every host from one metadata check.
